name: modelport
description: A local workbench to inspect, test, and approve AI API requests.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @modelport/core && concurrently --kill-others -n core,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @modelport/core" "npm run dev --workspace @modelport/server" "npm run dev --workspace @modelport/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @modelport/core && npm run build --workspace @modelport/web && npm run build --workspace @modelport/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @modelport/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
